name: create_sketch
description: Start a new sketch on an origin plane or on a face of the body.

plane.description: origin plane: XY (top plane), XZ (front plane), YZ (right plane)

face.description: body face to sketch on instead of a plane

offset.description: offset from the plane in mm

name: draw_rectangle
description: Draw a rectangle in the active sketch, centred on a point.

width.description: size along X in mm, the first number of 40x30

height.description: size along Y in mm, the second number of 40x30

name: draw_circle
description: Draw a circle in the active sketch.

diameter.description: diameter in mm, the number after Ø or 'dia'

name: draw_line
description: Draw a straight line in the active sketch between two points.

start_x.description: start X in mm, the point after 'from'

start_y.description: start Y in mm, the point after 'from'

end_x.description: end X in mm, the point after 'to'

end_y.description: end Y in mm, the point after 'to'

name: draw_slot
description: Draw a straight slot (obround) in the active sketch; 20x6 = length 20, width 6.

name: add_dimension
description: Add a driving dimension to entities of the active sketch.

value.description: dimension value in mm, or degrees for angle

entity_one.description: first entity number, e.g. the 2 of line 2

name: add_constraint
description: Add a geometric constraint between entities of the active sketch.

entity_one.description: first entity number, e.g. the 2 of line 2

name: extrude
description: Extrude (pad) the active sketch profile into a solid, or cut it out of the body (pocket).

distance.description: distance in mm: thickness, height or depth

operation.description: join adds material (boss), cut removes it (pocket)

direction.description: side of the sketch plane; symmetric = both sides

name: create_hole
description: Drill a hole into a face of the body.

diameter.description: hole diameter in mm, the number after Ø or 'dia'

depth.description: depth in mm of a blind hole; omit for a through hole

name: circular_pattern
description: Repeat a feature or body around an axis (polar pattern, circular array).

count.description: total number of instances, the number after x or ×

name: rectangular_pattern
description: Repeat a feature or body in a row or grid along X and Y (linear pattern).

name: mirror
description: Mirror a feature or body across an origin plane.

name: fillet
description: Round edges of the body with a radius.

radius.description: fillet radius in mm, the number after R

name: chamfer
description: Bevel edges of the body with an equal-distance chamfer.

name: shell
description: Hollow out the body, leaving walls of a given thickness and one face open.

name: undo
description: Undo the most recent operation.

name: redo
description: Redo the most recently undone operation.

name: draw_polygon
description: Draw a regular polygon such as a hexagon in the active sketch.

measure.description: size is across flats, across corners or one side

name: draw_arc
description: Draw a circular arc in the active sketch, counter-clockwise from a start to an end angle.

radius.description: radius in mm, the number after R

name: revolve
description: Revolve the active sketch profile around an origin axis into a solid (turned part).

operation.description: join adds material, cut removes it

name: combine
description: Boolean of bodies: join the other bodies to the first body, subtract them from it, or keep the overlap.

operation.description: join merges, cut subtracts, intersect keeps the overlap

name: move_body
description: Move the body by a distance along X, Y and Z.

name: set_material
description: Assign a physical material to the body.

name: set_parameter
description: Create a named user parameter or change its value.

name.description: parameter name exactly as written, e.g. wall_t

unit.description: unit of the value; none for a plain count

name: list_parameters
description: List the user parameters with their values.

name: measure_body
description: Report the size (bounding box), volume and mass of each body.

name: check_timeline
description: Check the timeline for features with errors or warnings.

name: capture_view
description: Take a screenshot of the model, optionally from a standard view direction.

direction.description: view to capture from; iso = isometric corner

name: fit_view
description: Zoom the view so the whole model fits the window.

name: export_model
description: Export the design to a file in a named format.

format.description: file format named in the request

name.description: file name without extension, exactly as written

name: new_document
description: Create a new empty design document.

name: save_document
description: Save the active document.

name: open_document
description: Find a saved document by name and open it.

name.description: document name or part of it, exactly as written

name: create_box
description: Create a box (block, cube) in one step, centred on the origin.

width.description: size along X in mm, the first number of 40x30x10

depth.description: size along Y in mm, the second number

height.description: size along Z (up) in mm, the third number

name: create_cylinder
description: Create a cylinder (rod, disc) in one step, standing on the origin.

diameter.description: diameter in mm, the number after Ø or 'dia'

name: center_hole
description: Drill a hole at the centre (middle) of a face of the body.

diameter.description: hole diameter in mm, the number after Ø or 'dia'

depth.description: depth in mm of a blind hole; omit for a through hole

name: corner_holes
description: Drill a hole near each corner of a face of the body.

margin.description: inset in mm from the edges

depth.description: depth in mm; omit for through holes

name: bolt_hole
description: Drill a clearance hole for a metric screw such as M6.

name: split_body
description: Split the body into two bodies at its middle (cut it in half).

direction.description: horizontal = top and bottom halves; vertical = across the longest side; lengthwise = along it

offset.description: distance in mm of the cut from the middle

name: copy_body
description: Duplicate the body: make copies of it in a row.

count.description: number of copies, the number before 'times' or 'copies'

spacing.description: distance in mm from one copy to the next; omit for side by side

name: set_thickness
description: Change the thickness (height) of the existing body by editing its extrude.

thickness.description: new thickness or height in mm

name: scale_body
description: Scale the body uniformly by a factor (resize, make bigger or smaller).

factor.description: scale factor as written: 2 doubles, 0.5 halves

name: rotate_body
description: Rotate the body in place by an angle around an axis.

axis.description: axis to rotate around; z is upright

name: delete_body
description: Delete the body from the design.

name: hide_body
description: Hide the body (make it invisible) without deleting it.

name: show_body
description: Show hidden bodies again (unhide).

name: set_color
description: Give the body a colour (appearance).
